Voynich MS - Quire 7

General

For an explanation of the material found on this page, see here.

Description

Quire 7 is a standard quire containing folios 49 through 56. The gathering mark is on f56v.

Schematic folio layout:

Folio 49

Normal folio. The folio nr. is on f49r.

f49r  

>>Link to 2014 scan (Beinecke digital library)

>>Link to 2004 scan (Jason Davies Voyager)

General description

This is a herbal page. For general information about herbal pages see here.
It has the folio nr (49) in the upper right corner.

Illustration(s)

Plant drawing: bulbous roots, a thin straight stem with two green bushels of leaves, and meandering tendrils with red buds and red and blue flowers. There are two snakes curling among the roots.

This plant shows some similarity with plant fragment #155 on f101r.

Herbal drawing characterisation (Gheuens/Rapaport):
α: flower(s) seen from the side
α: two or more leaf clusters/clumps

Text

This page has 21 text items (loci), as follows:
21 lines of standard text in paragraphs.

The text is in three paragraphs, in large writing filling most of the page.

Currier language: A
RZ language: A (page) / A (folio) / A (bifolio)
LFD hand: 1

Browse interlinear transliteration of f49r

Tentative identifications

ELV: convolvulus? ThP: tamus communis (Holm), Scammonia.

Other information

 

  f49v

>>Link to 2014 scan (Beinecke digital library)

>>Link to 2004 scan (Jason Davies Voyager)

General description

This is a herbal page. For general information about herbal pages see here.

There is a sequence of single Voynich characters just to the left of each of the lines, and the numbers 1-5 written to the left of lines 2-6.

Illustration(s)

A plant with a root like a fungus, a thin long stem, kidney-shaped leaves near the top and a very small blue flower.

Herbal drawing characterisation (Gheuens/Rapaport):
α: typical α calyx shape
α: stalk connects to leaf centre
α: everything is at the top of the stem
α: feature interrupts the main stem

Text

This page has 52 text items (loci), as follows:
26 lines of standard text in paragraphs;
26 stand-alone Voynich characters (labels).

The running text appears to be in three paragraphs. Its large writing fills most of the page. Offset to the left of each line is a single character in the Voynich script, mostly aligned accurately with each line. To the left of that, near the top, are the numbers 1 to 5 in a hand similar to the foliation of the MS.

Currier language: A
RZ language: A (page) / A (folio) / A (bifolio)
LFD hand: 1

Browse interlinear transliteration of f49v

Tentative identifications

ELV: Lunaria. ThP: lunaria, cyclamen (Holm), alpenveilchen.

Other information

Most of the Voynichese characters in the sequence on the left are the common set, but there are a few rare ones as well.
